title: User Roles: Setting Up and Managing User Permissions
summary: Explains how to create and assign Admin, Finance, and Auditor roles in user management (Add user/Edit user), apply granular permissions per segregation-of-duties, save changes, and invite users to activate access. Includes limits (max 15 users), fee ($0.00 one-time setup), and ongoing management steps (modify roles, suspend/restore access, periodic reviews, access certifications, audit evidence, and aligning permissions for payments/reconciliations/reviews).
faqs: How do I add or edit a user and assign the Admin, Finance, or Auditor role?
What granular permissions should be applied when assigning these roles?
What is the maximum number of users I can assign roles to?
